defect: overflow next value not assigned on every path
rationale: overflow_d is assigned only when the counter is enabled and no overflow is flagged, so in every other cycle the block holds its value in a latch.

mutation.description: Removed the default assignment of overflow_d at the top of the block.

author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Folded the sticky overflow variant into the top module with a wrap output.

labels.note: The combinational overflow value is not assigned when disabled or already overflowing.
